description: has_regression also fires on `new` nodes, so grackle diff exits 1 whenever a run exercises a code path the baseline didn't. ADR-0021 defines a regression as any hotter node and nothing else.

target.find: return any(e["status"] == "hotter" for e in entries)
target.replace: return any(e["status"] in ("hotter", "new") for e in entries)
